data.question_title: A man weighing 80 kg is standing in a trolley weighing 320 kg. The trolley is resting on frictionless horizontal rails. If the man starts walking on the trolley with a speed of 1 m / s, then after 4 sec his displacement relative to the ground will be
data.explanation_txt:
If the man starts walking on the trolley in the forward direction then whole system will move in backward direction with same momentum.

Momentum of man in forward direction = Momentum of system (man + trolley) in backward direction

\(\Rightarrow 80 \times 1 = ( 80 + 320 ) \times v \)

\(\Rightarrow v = 0.2 \mathrm { m } / \mathrm { s }\)

So the velocity of man w.r.t. ground \(=1.0 - 0.2 = 0.8 \mathrm { m } / \mathrm { s }\)

\(\therefore\) Displacement of man w.r.t. ground \(= 0.8 \times 4 = 3.2 \mathrm { m }\)
